newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 31.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 31.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to major shipping on Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
Pacific beach town ports Acapulco, Huatulco and Puerto Angel were closed to tourism and fishing boats because of high waves from Tropical Storm Guillermo, the report said.
Guillermo was reported 250 miles (400 km) south of Puerto Angel in Oaxaca state. The ministry warned ships from sailing in the Gulf of Tehuantepec, because of storms from the stationary Guillermo.
"The Guillermo Tropical Storm is expected to continue intensifying gradually," the ministry wrote. The storm was generating maximum winds from 40 to 50 knots (44 to 55 miles/76 to 95 km per hour).
Rains from the storm fell through southern Mexico, causing strong winds in the region and along the coasts of Nicaragua, Honduras and the Yucatan peninsula.
In the Gulf of Mexico, moderate rains were falling along the coasts of Veracruz, Tabasco and Campeche.
